scope: Only Git/JSON/links/bytes and agreement of literal result records. No coefficients, square roots, rational inequalities, expansions or counterexample values are evaluated. Mathematical evidence is the written analytical argument.
other_worktree_access: No other worktree content/index/lock/process/output reads or writes; no concurrent-state byte-invariance claim.

preservation.other_worktree_non_interference_check: Only own dedicated change scope and action boundary; no claim of invariance of concurrent other worktrees
preservation.snapshot_scope: All parent tracked file bytes and parent top-level untracked file bytes. No content/index/lock/process/output access in any other worktree, including concurrent F1/F2 and W1; their independent changes are not monitored. Non-interference is checked by the own dedicated change scope and action boundary, not by claiming all active areas are unchanged.
preservation.snapshot_publication: Full filesystem snapshots retained in task-local /tmp, not committed; public report provides scope/counts/hashes. Local observations, not immutable CI or external reproduction.
preservation.start_scope: Baseline snapshot taken after authorized own worktree registration, before document writes. Own new branch/worktree/common registration changes excluded from protected-other-worktree comparison.
preservation.writes: Only dedicated document directory in own worktree and own task-local /tmp. Own branch/index/commit metadata only. No other process/lock/index/content intentionally modified.
